title: The Godfather Part II
about: Michael tightens his grip on the empire while young Vito's rise plays out in old New York.
cue: Serve the mains when Michael kisses Fredo at the Havana countdown.
faces: The Malecón from the postcard rack in our lobby. Five minutes by taxi from our door.
The kitchen made my birthday cake in the shape of this island. Tonight they make it again, and everybody here gets a piece.
A kiss at midnight is customary. The cloakroom stays open for early exits.
SERVED FROM NINE UNTIL THE COUNTDOWN
The grand salón, Noche Vieja. Chandeliers, hats, the whole of Havana.
Saffron rice, beef ragù, peas and a mozzarella heart.
Ham, roast pork, Swiss, pickle, mustard, pressed hot.
Gulf shrimp on ice, lime, a sharp red sauce.
Eggplant and slow tomato, ricotta, blistered mozzarella.
Vanilla slab cake iced pale green, shaped like the island.
Rum, lime and sugar, ice cold. Banana on request.
Seating: by the family. The orchestra knows a tarantella.
Pesos, at par with the dollar. Prices subject to change. Form 74-II. Vedado, 1958.

    StartersArancini GencoSaffron rice, beef ragù, peas and a mozzarella heart.Fried in Genco olive oil, from New York.How to make it300g arborio rice900ml chicken stock1 pinch saffron threads40g parmesan, grated150g beef mince50g frozen peas2 tbsp passata60g mozzarella, cubed40g plain flour2 eggs, beaten100g breadcrumbs500ml neutral oil, for fryingCook the rice in the stock with the saffron, stirring, until thick. Stir in the parmesan, spread on a tray and chill, ideally overnight.Brown the mince with the peas and passata until thick and dry. Cool.Wrap golf-ball portions of cold rice around a spoon of filling and a cube of mozzarella.Roll in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.Fry in the oil at 175°C in batches until deep gold and hot through, then drain.MedianochesHam, roast pork, Swiss, pickle, mustard, pressed hot.The midnight sandwich, for the countdown.How to make it8 slider rolls2 tbsp yellow mustard150g leg ham, sliced150g roast pork, sliced8 slices of Swiss cheese4 dill pickles, sliced30g butter, meltedSplit the rolls and smear the cut sides with mustard.Layer with ham, pork, Swiss cheese and pickle.Brush the tops with melted butter.Press in a heavy pan over medium heat with a second pan on top, about 3 minutes a side, until the cheese melts.MainsZiti al fornoEggplant and slow tomato, ricotta, blistered mozzarella.For our guests from New York.How to make it1 large eggplant, diced4 tbsp olive oil2 garlic cloves, sliced700ml passata1 bunch basil500g ziti or penne400g ricotta50g parmesan, grated1 pinch ground nutmeg200g mozzarella, tornFry the eggplant in the oil until soft and browned, add the garlic for a minute, then the passata and half the basil, torn. Simmer slowly until thick.Cook the ziti or penne 3 minutes short of done and drain.Mix the ricotta with the parmesan, nutmeg and the rest of the basil, chopped.Layer pasta, sauce and ricotta in a baking dish and top with mozzarella.Bake at 200°C until blistered.SweetsTorta de la IslaVanilla slab cake iced pale green, shaped like the island.Keep your enemies closer. Cut at the table.How to make it200g butter, soft, for the cake200g caster sugar4 eggs250g self-raising flour100ml milk150g butter, soft, for icing300g icing sugargreen food colouring, a few dropsBeat the butter and caster sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour and milk.Bake in a lined slab tin at 180°C.Cool completely, then trim into a rough island shape.Beat the icing butter with icing sugar and colouring. Spread thinly, then again, and pipe happy birthday across.DrinksDaiquiriWhite rum, lime and sugar, shaken ice cold. Banana on request.Banana on request.How to make it60g caster sugar60ml hot water240ml white rum4 limes, juiced (about 100 ml)1 bag iceDissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool to make syrup.Chill four coupes.For each drink, shake rum, lime juice and syrup hard with plenty of ice, then double strain into a coupe.
